name: produce-game-2d-sprites
job: Produce engine-ready 2D game sprites and animation sheets with QC: chroma, loop, scale consistency, naming.

inScope: Producing characters, props, projectiles, FX, and HUD art assets
Building walk/run/attack/idle cycles and transparent exports
Applying engine-ready defaults and postprocessing scripts
Verifying with blind-describe QC and flip tests
outOfScope: Runtime wiring and ECS/render (Keel ports and title)
Faking engine-ready sheets when host tools are missing

inputs: Subject, style, frame count or grid, loop versus one-shot
Size class, naming, and success signal
Host image generation or editing tools
outputs: Engine-ready asset files with manifest and exact paths
QC notes including chroma, loop, scale, and consistency
Residual defects and host tool gaps

tools: Pillow or numpy (and ffmpeg for video path)
data: style contract and reference images for identity continuity
permissions: write access to the title assets tree

failureSemantics: Missing host tools are reported honestly, never papered over; sheets failing chroma, loop, scale, or consistency checks are residuals; helpers are only used per their documented --help contract.

outcome.observable: Engine-ready sprite or sheet files at declared title paths with manifest, QC evidence (chroma, loop flip test, scale consistency), and an honest residual and tool-gap list.
